comment: Spiral — a delay whose repeats climb or sink. A grain-re-triggered tap is read at `ratio` inside the FEEDBACK loop, so the shift compounds: repeat 1 is one step away, repeat 2 two steps, an endless staircase fading with the feedback. Rise sets a constant ratio (bipolar, unity at centre) for the discrete per-repeat staircase; Glide+Span are an onset-triggered ramp on that same ratio: a note resets the ramp to ZERO and it then climbs toward Glide's depth over Span, so the repeats begin at pitch and drift away over a while. That is the 'slowly rises for a while' behaviour; it is deliberately not a decay back to unity. Glide 0 = pure staircase; Rise centred + Glide up = pure glide with no net transposition. Ratio mapping is piecewise LINEAR, not 2^(semis/12), because the pedal cannot call exp2 without a helper call.
fxid_comment: 0x01C1. Free: no stock effect uses it, not a retired custom alias (checked against tools/effects_db.json). Sits just below the 450-459 custom block.

params.name: Div
params.comment: Musical division of the tempo below: 1/32, 1/16T, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/8, dotted 1/8, 1/4, dotted 1/4. Default 30 lands on 1/16, which at 120 BPM is the 125 ms that the old Time=17 produced.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM, read straight off the knob so the pedal's own number IS the tempo. Clamped to 40..240 in the DSP.

params.name: Feedbk
params.comment: Repeats, scaled to 0.965 and soft-clipped in the loop.

params.name: Rise
params.comment: Per-repeat ratio: 0 = octave down, 50 = unity, 100 = octave up.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: Depth of the onset-triggered ramp on that ratio.

params.name: Span
params.comment: How long the rise takes, ~0.19 s .. ~8 s.
